import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

numerical_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                  'Daily Steps', 'Heart Rate']
corr = df[numerical_cols].corr()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', square=True, 
            cbar_kws={"shrink": .8})
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=16)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
